about_the_game:
Super Kingcrab Simulator!

Super Kingcrab Simulator is a third-person destruction action-adventure game where you become a king crab, freeing countless abducted crabs while demolishing major cities.

1. Synopsis

You are the mightiest of all crabs, the "Super Kingcrab."

While investigating the mysterious mass disappearance of your kind, you witness something shocking: humans eating crabs.

Now, you have a mission. You must destroy crab restaurants to save countless crabs from being eaten and completely devastate the cities of the humans who consume them, using every method at your disposal.

2. Features

You, the player, are a crab.
Not just any crab—a supremely powerful Super Kingcrab.

A king crab can do anything. Hurl massive objects to damage other buildings, ride flying vehicles to cause chaos, or leap high and crash down to wreak havoc on your surroundings.

Free crabs or destroy buildings in any way you desire.

If you manage to demolish every building and obliterate humanity's cities? Well, you could choose to visit a crab restaurant yourself, become a delicious steamed crab dish, and solve humanity's food crisis.

Even so, you remain a deliciously fresh Super Kingcrab.
